description: A coin toss on every clock, in 2HP, choosing between two inputs for one output and between two outputs for one input

params.text: Switches what the probability knob means: by default it is the chance that B is chosen, and pressed it becomes the chance that the choice flips
Sets the probability, 0% fully counter-clockwise to 100% fully clockwise, at 50% in the centre
Attenuates and inverts the probability CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Sets the rate of the internal clock, from 0.0039Hz fully counter-clockwise to 1024Hz fully clockwise, and is ignored while a clock is patched

inputs.text: Moves the probability, 10V covering the knob's full travel at full trim
A rising edge tosses the coin; with the jack empty the internal clock does it at the knob's rate
One of the two signals for the upper section; an empty jack carries the voltage set for it on the menu, 10V for A and 0V for B
The signal routed to one of the two lower outputs; with the jack empty it reads the clock, which splits the clock between them

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the two upper inputs the toss chose
Carries the lower input while the toss chose this port, and otherwise a fixed voltage from the menu or the last value it carried

notes: leaving the lower input empty turns the module into a Bernoulli gate: each clock pulse goes to the A output or the B output
leaving both upper inputs empty makes the upper output a random high or low gate, from the 10V and 0V the menu normals it to
menu: Sections: shared or independent A/B — chooses whether the two sections share one toss or toss separately
A-normalized input, B-normalized input — sets the voltage an upper input carries when its jack is empty
Non selected A/B-output (fixed level) — sets the voltage the unselected lower output carries
Non selected A/B-output (mode): Fixed level, Last A/B-value — chooses whether the unselected lower output holds that fixed voltage or the last voltage it passed, tracked per channel
Clock rate chaos — picks a new random speed for each cycle of the internal clock, and does nothing while a clock is patched
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Auto select process quality — picks the process quality from the dialled-in rate and from which ports are patched, and greys out the manual choice while it is on
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the internal clock; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads 10V unless changed on the menu.
inputs.3:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V unless changed on the menu.
inputs.4:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the clock input.
